coach.checkRanksStale.detail: Ranks only change when a check runs. Run one to see where things stand now.
coach.checkRanksStale.title_one: Ranks were last checked {{count}} day ago
coach.checkRanksStale.title_other: Ranks were last checked {{count}} days ago
coach.competitorAbove.detail: In the stored results for tracked keywords, a competitor you follow comes before this app. Compare their name and subtitle with yours.
coach.competitorAbove.itemUnranked: {{name}} is {{competitorRank}} for {{term}}; you are not in the results
coach.followCompetitors.detail: Seeing what a similar app puts in its name and subtitle shows words you may be missing. Apps that show up for several of your keywords can be suggested.
coach.followCompetitors.title: Follow a competitor
coach.keywordFieldWaste.detail: Spaces after commas, empty or repeated entries, and entries the name or subtitle already hold take room from words that could be added. UNVERIFIED that the store ignores repeats across fields.
coach.notInListing.detailApple: None of their words appear in the name, subtitle or keyword field, so the store has little reason to show the app for them.
coach.notInListing.detailPlay: None of their words appear in the title, short or full description, so the store has little reason to show the app for them.
coach.notInListing.title_one: {{count}} tracked keyword is not in the listing
coach.notInListing.title_other: {{count}} tracked keywords are not in the listing
coach.rankDropped.detail_one: Down at least {{count}} place, or out of the top 10, between the last two checks.
coach.rankDropped.detail_other: Down at least {{count}} places, or out of the top 10, between the last two checks.
coach.trackKeywords.detail: A keyword is a word or phrase people might search for. Tracking one records where the app appears in the store results for it.
coach.trackKeywords.title: Track your first keywords
coach.untappedLocale.detail: A locale with no text gives the store nothing to match in that language. A storefront may also read other locales of the listing (UNVERIFIED).
coach.untappedLocale.itemEmptyKeywordFie: {{locale}}: the keyword field is empty (tracked in {{markets}})
coach.untappedLocale.itemEmptyShortDescr: {{locale}}: the short description is empty (tracked in {{markets}})
coach.untrackedSet.detail: These are in the keyword field of the listing, but no rank is recorded for them, so you cannot tell whether they help. Tracking one only reads the public store.
coach.unusedCharacters.detail: Characters not used are words the store cannot match. Fill them only with words that describe the app.
play.check.codeAlreadyLive: Version code {{codes}} is already in a release of {{track}} that is live or rolling out. Choose a code that is not released there yet.
play.check.codeInvalid: A version code is a whole number.
play.check.codeNotNewer: Version code {{codes}} is lower than {{highest}}, which {{track}} already holds. People who have {{highest}} are not offered a lower code, so they will not get this release.
play.check.codesMissing: Choose at least one version code for the release.
play.check.fractionOutOfRange: The share of users must be more than 0% and at most 100%. Google Play keeps a share only between 0 and 1, and 100% is a completed release.
play.check.fullRollout: 100% is sent to Google Play as a completed release with no share: everybody gets it at once.
play.check.nameEmpty: The release name is empty. It is only shown in Play Console, but a name (for example the version) makes the release easy to find.
play.check.notesMissing: There are no release notes for {{locale}}, a language that has a listing.
play.check.notesNone: The release has no release notes. Players see an empty "What is new".
play.check.notesOverLimit: The release notes for {{locale}} have {{count}} characters. Google Play allows at most {{max}} per language.
play.check.trackMissing: Name the track to release in.
play.fractionRefused: Google Play did not accept a staged rollout for this app. Release to everyone (100%) instead, or change "Staged rollout on Google Play" in the settings of the app. Nothing was retried.
play.offer.firstRelease: This is the first release in production: Google Play does not offer a staged rollout for it. It goes to everyone (100%).
play.offer.never: A staged rollout is switched off for this app (Staged rollout on Google Play in its settings). The release goes to everyone (100%).
rollout.action.doneCannotSkip: A step that is done cannot be skipped. Reopen it first.
rollout.action.earlierOpen: Complete or skip the earlier steps first.
rollout.action.laterDone: Reopen the later steps that are done first.
rollout.appleNote: Apple releases to users with automatic updates over 7 days on a fixed schedule. This is shown for information: the percentages cannot be changed, and the share Apple has reached is not read from the store.
rollout.compare.canConfirm: You can confirm the next step from the store.
rollout.compare.halted: The store has the rollout halted.
rollout.compare.planNone: the plan has no step done yet
rollout.compare.planStep: the plan has step {{index}} of {{total}} ({{percent}}) done
rollout.compare.storeBehind: {{said}}, behind the plan: {{plan}}. Check the console, or reopen the steps that are not true. {{tail}}
rollout.compare.unknownApple: The share of an Apple phased release is not read from the store, so the plan cannot be compared. {{tail}}
rollout.compare.unknownNone: The store has not reported this version yet.
rollout.compare.unknownStore: The store reports no rollout share for this version. {{tail}}
rollout.issue.afterCreated: Plan a step after the plan was created.
rollout.issue.afterPrevious: A step cannot be planned before the step above it.
rollout.issue.beforeDone: A step before a completed step must be done or skipped.
rollout.issue.doneCannotRemove: The step at {{percent}} is done and cannot be removed. Reopen it first.
rollout.issue.doneKeepsPercent: A step that is done keeps its percentage. Reopen it first.
rollout.issue.higherThanBefore: Each step must be higher than the one before ({{percent}}).
rollout.issue.needStep: A rollout plan needs at least one step.
rollout.issue.noteLength: One line of at most {{max}} characters.
rollout.issue.tooMany: A rollout plan can have {{max}} steps at most.
rollout.issue.unknownStep: This step does not exist. Reload and try again.
rollout.template.applePhased.description: Apple releases to automatic updates over 7 days: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100% on days 1 to 7. The schedule is fixed by Apple, so it is shown for information and the percentages cannot be edited.
rollout.template.applePhased.name: App Store phased release (7 days)
rollout.template.immediate.description: No staging: everyone gets the version at once.
rollout.template.immediate.name: Immediate release to 100%
rollout.template.playDefault.description: A cautious ramp for Google Play. Play lets you choose any share; these numbers are our suggestion, not a Play default.
rollout.template.playDefault.name: Staged rollout: 1, 5, 20, 50, 100%
